text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
choice_data_list: Are you short on sleep, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
A... Actually, I... overheard it. In the 
dead of night, during the witching hour, 
when everyone was asleep—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: The buzz of insect wings, bzzzt!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"What if it got into my futon...!? What if 
it landed on my face and did something!?" 
My heart was pounding like crazy until 
morning...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, I hope they'll be gone tonight.

It seems Rhine Kraft couldn't get a good 
rest because a bug got into her room.
